title: FlightEventPayload
description: Canonical flight payload carried inside an InboundEventEnvelope with event_type=flight.update. Mirrors the FlightLeg entity in AEROOPS_SYSTEM_DESIGN.md section 4. Scheduled, estimated and actual times are always distinguished; never infer actual from estimated.

external_id.description: Source system's identifier for this flight leg, unique per tenant.

service_date.description: Local operational date of the flight, used to disambiguate flight number reuse.

origin.description: IATA/ICAO code of the origin station.

destination.description: IATA/ICAO code of the destination station.

lifecycle.description: Coarse flight state, e.g. SCHEDULED, INBOUND, ON_BLOCK, TURNAROUND, READY, OFF_BLOCK, CANCELLED.
